content: For the sake of comparison, let us consider the Rotowire corpus BIBREF3 containing basketball game summaries and statistics, which was recently released and has become a popular data set for training data-to-text generation systems (cf., e.g., BIBREF4, BIBREF1, BIBREF5). The Rotowire game summaries are straightforward in their style of reporting, focusing on the game at hand and tend for the most part to reference facts in the statistics. By contrast, our news corpus is more heterogeneous, including both articles focusing on the particular game and articles that take a broader perspective (e.g., describing a player's career). The STT news articles tend to read in the journalist's voice, putting substantial emphasis on the character of the game, often in colorful language, as well as quoting players and coaches.
